name: Peacefield
summary: A calm, cooperative kingdom that will do anything to protect its peace.
description: Peace is the heart of Peacefield. This is a kingdom for players who value calm, cooperation, and a quiet corner of the world to call home, and its people will do everything in their power to protect that peace.

name: Rosewood
summary: A kingdom with a story still being written.
description: The story of Rosewood is still being written. Check back soon, or ask about it in our Discord.

name: Solyra
summary: Ruled by the Goddess of Death, with Greek, Italian, and desert builds and a fully shared community.
description: Ruled by the Goddess of Death herself, Solyra is a kingdom of Greek, Italian, and desert-inspired architecture. Its people are proud to work as one community, with shared storage, shared resources, and shared villagers. In Solyra, everyone builds together and everyone benefits.

name: Subterra
summary: A civilization beneath the surface: part trading hub, part stronghold.
description: What lies beneath the world belongs to those willing to dig for it. Subterra is a civilization below the surface: a growing community, a trading center, and a defensive stronghold, all carved from the depths.
